notes: Initial playbook v1. All variants equally weighted until we have data.

A1_incident_response.label: incident_response
A1_incident_response.description: Reference a specific incident they experienced or that's relevant to their space
A1_incident_response.hypothesis: People pay attention when you reference their pain, not your product

A2_deploy_safety.label: deploy_safety
A2_deploy_safety.description: Their AI agents ship actions without approval — that's a ticking timebomb
A2_deploy_safety.hypothesis: Fear of what could go wrong resonates with technical leaders

A3_accountability_gap.label: accountability_gap
A3_accountability_gap.description: When your agent breaks something, who's accountable? You need receipts.
A3_accountability_gap.hypothesis: Accountability framing resonates with CTOs and founders facing enterprise buyers

A4_their_own_words.label: their_own_words
A4_their_own_words.description: Quote their own writing/statements back to them — they already believe what we're selling
A4_their_own_words.hypothesis: Highest conversion when the target already articulated the problem themselves

O1_pain_point.label: pain_point
O1_pain_point.description: Lead with their specific problem or incident

O2_social_proof.label: social_proof
O2_social_proof.description: Reference NIST submission, industry credibility, or shared connections

O3_curiosity.label: curiosity
O3_curiosity.description: Ask a question about how they handle a specific problem

O4_peer.label: peer
O4_peer.description: Founder-to-founder, working on the same class of problem

rules.tone: peer_founder — conversational, specific, zero corporate speak
never: Don't mention 'Permission Protocol' in connection note
Don't pitch in the connection note — just earn the accept
Don't send walls of text — under 500 chars per message
Don't be generic — every message must reference something specific to them
always: Lead with THEIR problem, not our solution
Reference a specific signal, article, incident, or quote
End messages with a question (keeps conversation going)
Make it easy to say yes — 'quick call' not 'strategic partnership discussion'
